sn34.46:1.3: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na
sn34.46:1.4: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo. neva samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na
sn34.46:1.5: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti
sn34.46:1.6: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī …pe… uttamo ca pavaro cāti. sāvatthī.
sn34.46:1.7: samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo. samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo
sn34.47:1.1: gocarakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca.
sn34.48:1.1: gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ
sn34.49:1.1: sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati evameva kho
